folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Replace only if three-seed BA improves by about 0.01, AUROC by about 0.015, Macro-F1 does not decline, DD recall does not materially decline, most of 15 seed-averaged splits improve, and seed stability does not materially worsen.
